name: De Vondeltuin
funFact: Amsterdam’s first circular municipal building opened here in2020. DOOR architecten drew inspiration from the neighboring Batak-style hut and used roof shingles made from Amsterdam trees, reused window-frame hardwood and a floor recovered from a gymnasium.
description: A timber pavilion with two offset roofs, glass gable ends and projecting wooden sunshades beside Vondelpark’s playground.
